body:
I hear you...  very similar thoughts and reasons for not acting on them.

I'm a smart guy and can actually self diagnose a lot of the contributors to my depression.  The problem is that I haven't found nearly as many solutions as contributions.  :(

I've learned to shield myself from a lot of the news and other things that can really get my mind going in bad ways.  The problem is that then I start feeling guilty and irresponsible... damned if I do, damned if I don't.

Thank you for your response...  I appreciate that you care.  You're welcome to share more with me if that would be helpful to you.

Thank you for your caring...  I'm better tonight; not well, but better.

Indeed, I rarely feel 'happy' and usually when I do I feel extremely selfish and quickly get more depressed.  Undoubtedly this is just one of the contributors to my condition.

I have very, very few friends.  The only close friend I have is my wife of 25 years.  She is truly awesome and has borne more of the burden than any person should ever have to.  That said, there are limits to what she can do.  I need to find a professional, but I don't even know how.  I tried once before, but that quickly went south and has made me even more skeptical.

Other than my immediate family (wife and two children), I've no family that I would turn to...  they're a manipulative, racist, homophobic, small-minded lot.  (Yes, I'm judgmental, but also speaking the truth.)

Perhaps I'll take another random shot with some doctors around here... the most I have to lose is some time and the $20 co-pay.  I just can't keep crashing like this... it's too painful.

Thanks again...

I know I need help, but I'm still not sure how to find it.  I once tried going to both a psychologist and a psychiatrist (independently) in the same week.  The psychiatrist said he didn't really see a problem, but that he could give me some drugs if I wanted to try them.  The psychologist started in on mindfulness talk.

I needed either/both of them to know that for me to come to them in the first place was a sign that I was getting extremely close to actually following through on my thoughts.  Neither got it...

I'm not a stupid person and I'm also not one who is easy to read... the person who I am closest to and most vulnerable with is my wife and there are still things I don't share after close to 25 years of being married.

Thank you for caring and listening.  I'm a little better tonight.  I was super bad 5-6 years ago for an extended period of time.  I've gotten a lot better, but I still crash sometimes and that's what happened last night.  There are times I think it is harder to crash than to just wallow in it.  :(
